acceptanceCriteria: A read-only command prints a canonical CREATE payload for the current queue that ticket create accepts after only title, body and acceptanceCriteria are filled in, covered by a test
The template output names each enum's allowed values and which keys may be null
The command writes nothing and takes no lock
body: Filed 2026-10-04 under V1-0720 item 2 (memory corvint-tasks-ticket-create-payload). On corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202, ticket create --help now lists the 20 payload keys and the canonical rules, and refusals name enum values ('/payload/kind: value "QUESTION" not in {FEATURE|BUG|CHORE|SPIKE|DOC|MANUAL|EXTERNAL}') and missing keys ('closed object violated (missing keys: owner)'), so the enum half of the memory is resolved. Still missing: the value types and the nested shapes (effects {coverage, externalUnbounded, resources, touchPaths}, source {kind, sourceItemId, sourceQueueId, sourceRevisionSha256}, null-able keys, the order string) are discoverable only by refusal or by copying a saved memory, and source.sourceQueueId must be guessed from queue.json. Expected: a read-only command (for example ticket create --template) that prints a canonical, valid native payload for this queue with placeholder title, body and acceptance criteria and every enum's allowed values, so an agent edits three fields and submits. Related: V1-0329, V1-0628.

completion.reason: Every acceptance criterion is met: `ticket create --template` prints a canonical CREATE payload (CAL-V0-073) naming enum values and nullable keys, reads only the intent store and takes no lock, and the template filled with title, body and acceptanceCriteria round-trips through `ticket create --payload-stdin` to an OPEN ticket (TestCALV0073_* in internal/tasks/cli). Integrated by beamfall/corvint#562 (merge 10570f60) and #594 (merge 21375c4e, routes the template through repo.IntentRoot()). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0751-create-payload-template.md at 10570f60. Independent review done; make gate and the dogfood seal are NOT_RUN for this scoped change. Completed on the owner's confirmation in the orchestrator session, 2026-10-05.

title: corvint-tasks: emit a complete fill-in payload template for ticket create, including nested effects and source shapes
